meta.name: pr-to-video
meta.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一次代码改动自动生成一条讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常需要向团队讲清某次代码改动做了什么
copy.tagline_en: Turn a code change into a narrated explainer video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain what a code change did

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 gh 读取一个 GitHub PR 的 diff、提交和文件,规划并逐帧构建代码变更讲解视频(changelog、功能揭示、修复或重构走查),最后渲染出 video.mp4。
howto.when: 当你说出 PR 链接、「owner/repo#N」,或在已检出的仓库里说「this PR」时触发;输入是代码变更而不是网站,意图不明确时改走 /hyperframes。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude reads a GitHub PR's diff, commits, and files via gh, plans it, and builds a code-change explainer video frame by frame (changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough), rendering video.mp4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you give a PR URL, an owner/repo#N ref, or say "this PR" in a checked-out repo; the input is a code change, not a website.

say_en.text: Turn owner/repo#1842 into an explainer video
say_en.note: Fetches PR facts and builds frames

say_en.text: Make a feature-reveal video from this PR link
Use "this PR" in the checked-out repo for a fix explainer
